title: Running Tests in Parallel
why: 最近两天阅读理解度都是100%，且这篇是从前一天「安装 Playwright」自然延伸到「运行测试」，适合小幅提升难度，同时复现本周正在学的生词和语法02时态。
focus: 读的时候注意哪些句子用现在时（讲一般规则），哪些用过去时（讲上周发生的具体例子），先找出每句的主干。
text:
Playwright can run your tests in parallel. This means several tests run at the same time, not one after another. By default, Playwright uses several workers, and each worker runs tests independently.

You can specify how many workers you want. For example, this command tells Playwright to use four workers:

npx playwright test --workers=4

Sometimes a test depends on data from another test. This is not a good practice. Each test should work on its own, without relying on other tests.

Playwright also creates a report after the tests finish. The report shows which tests passed and which tests failed. If a test fails, the report shows a screenshot and the corresponding error message.

Last week, a tester ran 50 tests in parallel and finished in two minutes. Before that, the same tests ran one by one and took ten minutes.

Running tests in parallel saves a lot of time. But it only works well when tests do not depend on each other.

glossary.meaning: 并行（同时进行，而不是一个接一个）
（这里指）同时跑测试的进程/工作单元
独立地，不依赖别的东西

questions.q: What does "running tests in parallel" mean?
questions.a: 同时运行多个测试，而不是一个接一个地运行

questions.q: How can you tell Playwright to use four workers?
Why is it a problem if one test depends on another test?
questions.a: 因为这样测试就不能独立运行，一个测试出问题可能牵连到别的测试，不好定位原因，也不稳定
